what: npm publish uses a separate README from the GitHub public repo. npm README (short, utilitarian — install + setup + MCP config) vs GitHub README (longer, marketing — problem statement, features, demo GIFs, comparison). Since npm pulls README from package root at publish time and we publish from private aide-v0 repo, need a README.npm.md that gets copied to README.md before npm publish, then restored.
why: Decision made during Phase 0/1 planning — two different audiences need different READMEs, and the npm publish workflow from the private repo requires a swap step.
